themes.title: Manuel Adorni scandal paralyzes Argentina's government
themes.blurb: Argentina's government faces paralysis after Manuel Adorni's resignation as Chief of Staff amid corruption allegations. The scandal has triggered a cabinet reshuffle, with Diego Santilli appointed as his replacement, and has dominated political discourse across right-wing and libertarian factions in Argentina.

themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are advocating for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to social services, housing, and employment. This theme has gained traction in Spain, Italy, France, and Hungary, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, and Rassemblement National leading the charge.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights in Europe

This theme is evident in Spain, Hungary, Italy, and France, with parties like Vox, Fidesz, Fratelli d'Italia, and Rassemblement National leading anti-LGBTQ+ legislation and rhetoric.
